name: Kida Burns
milestone_by_age_26: Won So You Think You Can Dance: The Next Generation in 2016 at age 14, claiming the title of America's Favorite Dancer and a $250,000 prize.
starting_point: Born in Sacramento, California to a working-class family; began dancing at age four and trained at Chapkis Dance Studio under SYTYCD alum Greg Chapkis from age 11. His father passed away from flu complications in 2014.
current_position: Active hip-hop dancer, choreographer, and social media personality known as Kida The Great, with a large Instagram following and ongoing performance and choreography work.

trajectory.title: Started dancing
trajectory.description: Began dancing at age four in Sacramento, developing an early passion for hip-hop movement and musicality.

trajectory.title: Began formal training at Chapkis Dance Studio
trajectory.description: Started training under Greg Chapkis, a So You Think You Can Dance Season 1 contestant, at Chapkis Dance Studio in Suisun City, California.

trajectory.title: National TV appearances
trajectory.description: Performed solo on The Queen Latifah Show and The Rachael Ray Show, catching the attention of So You Think You Can Dance producers.

trajectory.title: Won So You Think You Can Dance: The Next Generation
trajectory.description: Crowned America's Favorite Dancer on Season 13 of SYTYCD, winning $250,000 and the cover of Dance Spirit magazine, defeating runner-up JT Church in the live finale.

trajectory.title: Performed with Usher at BET Awards
trajectory.description: Danced on stage with Usher at the 2016 BET Awards and appeared in Chris Brown's music video for 'Party' alongside Ayo & Teo.

trajectory.title: Continued professional dance career
trajectory.description: Leveraged SYTYCD fame into ongoing professional dance work, choreography, and social media content creation, building a substantial Instagram following.

trajectory.title: Expanded social media presence
trajectory.description: Built a large following on Instagram and TikTok, sharing dance videos and choreography, establishing himself as a global dance phenomenon.

trajectory.title: Active choreographer and performer
trajectory.description: Continues to perform, choreograph, and create dance content, maintaining his status as one of the most recognized young hip-hop dancers in the world.

name: Elizaveta Kokoreva
milestone_by_age_26: Promoted to principal dancer (prima ballerina) at the Bolshoi Ballet in 2023 at age 22, becoming the youngest ever prima ballerina in the Bolshoi's history.
starting_point: Born in Moscow into a ballet family; her father is a dancer and her mother is a psychologist. She decided to become a ballet dancer after seeing Don Quixote as a child.
current_position: Prima ballerina at the Bolshoi Ballet, continuing to dance leading roles and making international guest appearances.

trajectory.title: Grishko Foundation scholarship
trajectory.description: Received a scholarship from the Grishko Foundation (2011-2014), marking early recognition of her exceptional ballet talent.

trajectory.title: Won All-Russian Young Talents competition
trajectory.description: Won the All-Russian competition Young Talents of Russia in 2016 and again in 2018, establishing herself as a top young dancer nationally.

trajectory.title: International ballet competition success
trajectory.description: Won 1st Prize at the XIII International Competition of Ballet Dancers and Choreographers in Moscow and received the International Federation of Ballet Competitions Best Duet Prize.

trajectory.title: Graduated and joined Bolshoi Ballet
trajectory.description: Graduated from the Moscow State Academy of Choreography under teacher Tatyana Galtseva and was immediately accepted into the Bolshoi Ballet Company, with her first principal role (Maria in The Nutcracker) coming within two months.

trajectory.title: Promoted to Soloist
trajectory.description: After three years in the corps de ballet while dancing solo and leading roles, was promoted to the rank of Soloist at the Bolshoi.

trajectory.title: Promoted to First Soloist
trajectory.description: Elevated to First Soloist (Leading Soloist) at the end of the 2021-2022 season, continuing her rapid ascent through the Bolshoi ranks.

trajectory.title: Promoted to Prima Ballerina
trajectory.description: Became the youngest ever prima ballerina in Bolshoi history at age 22, announced on stage after a performance of The Pharaoh's Daughter on April 1, 2023.

trajectory.title: International debut and guest appearances
trajectory.description: Made her Western debut at the Les Étoiles galas in Rome in January 2025 and guested with Hong Kong Ballet in The Sleeping Beauty, expanding her international profile.

name: Joy Womack
milestone_by_age_26: Became a principal dancer at the Kremlin Ballet Theatre of Moscow in 2014 at age 19, after being the first American woman to graduate from the Bolshoi Ballet Academy's main training program and sign a contract with the Bolshoi Ballet.
starting_point: Born in Beverly Hills, California; began formal ballet training at age four at Westside Academy of Ballet, later training at the Kirov Academy of Ballet in Washington, DC before moving to Moscow at age 15.
current_position: Freelance guest artist based in Paris; artistic and executive director of the Joy Womack Ballet Company, Foundation, and Academy; author of memoir 'Behind the Red Velvet Curtain.'

trajectory.title: Moved to Moscow for Bolshoi Academy
trajectory.description: Relocated alone to Moscow to attend the Bolshoi Ballet Academy, becoming one of the first Americans selected for the Russian Program.

trajectory.title: First American to sign with Bolshoi Ballet
trajectory.description: Became the first American woman to sign a soloist contract with the Bolshoi Ballet Theater, graduating with a Red Diploma from the Russian Program.

trajectory.title: Left Bolshoi amid corruption allegations
trajectory.description: Quit the Bolshoi after accusing the theater of extortion, claiming she was told to pay $10,000 to perform or find a patron.

trajectory.title: Principal dancer at Kremlin Ballet
trajectory.description: Became a principal dancer at the Kremlin Ballet Theatre of Moscow, premiering as Marie in The Nutcracker attended by US Ambassador Michael McFaul.

trajectory.title: Left Kremlin Ballet
trajectory.description: Departed the Kremlin Ballet to pursue new opportunities, transitioning to international guest performances.

trajectory.title: Principal dancer at Universal Ballet Seoul
trajectory.description: Joined Universal Ballet in Seoul, South Korea as a principal dancer, expanding her international career.

trajectory.title: Joined Boston Ballet
trajectory.description: Joined the Boston Ballet as an artist, continuing her career in the United States.

trajectory.title: Prima ballerina at Astrakhan Opera and Ballet
trajectory.description: Returned to Russia as prima ballerina at the Astrakhan Opera and Ballet Theatre.

trajectory.title: Documentary released
trajectory.description: A full-length documentary titled 'Joy Womack: The White Swan' was released globally, documenting seven years of her journey in Russian ballet.

trajectory.title: Paris Opera Ballet contract and memoir
trajectory.description: Secured a fixed-term contract with Paris Opera Ballet in January 2023 and published her memoir 'Behind the Red Velvet Curtain,' now based in Paris as a freelance artist.

name: Freddy Macdonald
milestone_by_age_26: His short film Sew Torn was acquired by Searchlight Pictures in 2019 and qualified for Academy Award consideration after a nationwide theatrical release alongside Ready or Not.
starting_point: Born in Santa Monica, California to a filmmaking family; his father Fred Macdonald was CEO of animation company Olive Jar Studios and had worked with Disney and Dreamworks. The family relocated to Switzerland during his teens.
current_position: Film director whose feature debut Sew Torn premiered at SXSW 2024, headlined Locarno, streamed on Netflix, and received 95% on Rotten Tomatoes; represented by UTA.

trajectory.title: Early filmmaking with father
trajectory.description: Began co-writing scripts and making films with his father Fred Macdonald, developing a collaborative creative partnership from a young age.

trajectory.title: Sew Torn short acquired by Searchlight Pictures
trajectory.description: His six-minute short film, made as part of his AFI application, was acquired by Searchlight Pictures and received an Oscar-qualifying theatrical release alongside Ready or Not, executive produced by Peter Spears.

trajectory.title: Youngest AFI directing fellow and UTA signing
trajectory.description: Accepted to the American Film Institute Conservatory as the youngest directing fellow ever, and signed with United Talent Agency after Joel Coen viewed his short and advised him.

trajectory.title: Student Academy Award for Shedding Angels
trajectory.description: His AFI graduating thesis film Shedding Angels won a Student Academy Award and was shortlisted for a student BAFTA.

trajectory.title: Feature debut Sew Torn premiered at SXSW
trajectory.description: His feature-length expansion of Sew Torn, directed at age 21, premiered at South by Southwest Film Festival to glowing reviews, with The Hollywood Reporter calling him a 'wunderkind.'

trajectory.title: Headlined Locarno Film Festival
trajectory.description: Sew Torn headlined the Locarno Film Festival on the Piazza Grande and was an official selection at Sitges and Camerimage festivals.

trajectory.title: Theatrical release and Netflix streaming
trajectory.description: Sew Torn received a North American theatrical release in May 2025 and became available to stream on Netflix in December 2025, earning 95% on Rotten Tomatoes and widespread critical acclaim.

name: João Gonzalez
milestone_by_age_26: His animated short film Ice Merchants premiered at Cannes Critics' Week in May 2022 and won the Leitz Cine Discovery Prize, making him the first Portuguese animation filmmaker awarded at Cannes.
starting_point: Born in Porto, Portugal in 1996; studied Multimedia Arts at ESMAD with a specialization in animation, and later received a Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation scholarship for a Masters at the Royal College of Art in London. Also classically trained in piano.
current_position: Oscar-nominated Portuguese director, animator, and composer based in Porto, working at the COLA animation collective and developing new film projects.

trajectory.title: BA graduation film The Voyager
trajectory.description: His final BA project at ESMAD, The Voyager, received the International New Talent Award at the BFI Future Film Festival and Best Student Film at CINANIMA.

trajectory.title: Entered Royal College of Art
trajectory.description: Began a Masters in Animation at the Royal College of Art in London on a Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation scholarship, where he developed his artistic voice.

trajectory.title: Nestor wins awards
trajectory.description: His first-year RCA film Nestor received the António Gaio Award at CINANIMA and Best Student Film Award at the Quirino Awards.

trajectory.title: Ice Merchants premieres at Cannes
trajectory.description: Ice Merchants premiered at Cannes Film Festival's Critics' Week and won the Jury Prize for Best Short Film, making him the first Portuguese animation filmmaker awarded at Cannes.

trajectory.title: First Portuguese Oscar nomination
trajectory.description: Ice Merchants became the first Portuguese production ever to receive an Academy Award nomination, and won the Annie Award, with over 130 international awards total.

trajectory.title: Columbia fellowship and new projects
trajectory.description: Selected as a fellow at Columbia University's Institute for Ideas and Imagination, working on a new film about regret, forgiveness, and communication.

name: Gints Zilbalodis
milestone_by_age_26: His debut feature film Away, which he wrote, directed, animated, and scored entirely alone, premiered at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in 2019 and won the Contrechamp Award.
starting_point: Born in Riga, Latvia in 1994; started animating at age eight using Flash software, became serious about filmmaking at 15, and studied painting and drawing at Janis Rozentāls Art School in Riga.
current_position: Academy Award-winning Latvian filmmaker whose film Flow won Best Animated Feature at the 97th Academy Awards and the 82nd Golden Globe Awards; honored as Rigan of the Year 2024.

trajectory.title: Started animating
trajectory.description: Began using Flash software to make internet cartoons at age eight, developing an early passion for animation and filmmaking.

trajectory.title: First short film Rush
trajectory.description: Created his first short film Rush, becoming more serious about animation and exploring 3D CGI filmmaking.

trajectory.title: Short film Oasis nominated for awards
trajectory.description: His short film Oasis was nominated for numerous Latvian film awards and served as the basis for his debut feature Away.

trajectory.title: Away wins Contrechamp Award at Annecy
trajectory.description: His solo-created debut feature Away, written/directed/animated/scored entirely by himself over three and a half years, premiered at Annecy and won the Contrechamp Award.

trajectory.title: Away nominated for Annie Award
trajectory.description: Away was nominated for an Annie Award for Outstanding Achievement for Music in a Feature Production, gaining international recognition.

trajectory.title: Flow selected for Cannes Un Certain Regard
trajectory.description: His second feature Flow, his first collaborative project with a team across Latvia, France, and Belgium, was selected for the Un Certain Regard section at the 2024 Cannes Film Festival.

trajectory.title: Won Academy Award and Golden Globe for Flow
trajectory.description: Flow won Best Animated Feature at the 97th Academy Awards and the 82nd Golden Globe Awards, making him the first Latvian to win an Oscar; he was also honored as Rigan of the Year 2024.

name: Avalon Fast
milestone_by_age_26: Their debut feature film Honeycomb world-premiered at the 2022 Slamdance Film Festival at age 21, and their second feature CAMP won the Next Wave Best Feature Award at Fantastic Fest.
starting_point: From Vancouver Island, Canada; began making films in high school, developing a DIY filmmaking practice rooted in femme friendships and the natural splendor of her native region.
current_position: 25-year-old filmmaker whose sophomore feature CAMP is in theatrical release and on VOD, with a forthcoming project centered on filmmaker Jane Schoenbrun; also active as an actor in independent genre films.

trajectory.title: Early short filmmaking
trajectory.description: Began making short films during high school, many leaning toward the macabre and exploring dark, genre-defying themes.

trajectory.title: Honeycomb premiered at Slamdance
trajectory.description: Debut feature Honeycomb, a DIY surrealist film about girls starting their own society, world-premiered at the 2022 Slamdance Film Festival, shot on a microbudget with friends.

trajectory.title: CAMP launched at Fantasia Frontières Market
trajectory.description: Second feature CAMP was launched at the Fantasia International Film Festival's Frontières Market, beginning development of the witchy coming-of-age film.

trajectory.title: CAMP wins Next Wave Best Feature at Fantastic Fest
trajectory.description: CAMP won the Next Wave Best Feature Award at Fantastic Fest and screened at the Brooklyn Horror Film Festival as the centerpiece film.

trajectory.title: CAMP theatrical and VOD release
trajectory.description: CAMP received select theatrical bookings and VOD release in July 2025, earning 91% on Rotten Tomatoes and critical acclaim for its visual evolution from Honeycomb.

name: Danny and Michael Philippou
milestone_by_age_26: By age 26 (2018), their YouTube channel RackaRacka had amassed over 1 billion views and 6.5 million subscribers, won a Streamy Award for Best International YouTube Channel (2015) and an AACTA Award for Best Online Video or Series (2017).
starting_point: Twin brothers from Adelaide, South Australia, of Greek heritage; began making amateur movies at age seven, inspired by RL Stine's Goosebumps novels, and started creating 'fake fail' videos for Facebook before launching RackaRacka on YouTube in 2013.
current_position: Filmmakers whose debut feature Talk to Me grossed $92M globally for A24 and whose second film Bring Her Back was released in 2025; based in Australia with 6.88M YouTube subscribers and 1.16B views.

trajectory.title: Launched RackaRacka YouTube channel
trajectory.description: Started the RackaRacka YouTube channel (named after their home suburb Pooraka), initially creating 'fake fail' videos and horror comedy content, financed by Danny volunteering for paid medical trials.

trajectory.title: Harry Potter vs Star Wars goes viral
trajectory.description: Their Harry Potter vs Star Wars video went viral with 34 million views, catapulting the channel to widespread recognition.

trajectory.title: Won Streamy Award for Best International YouTube Channel
trajectory.description: Received the Streamy Award for Best International YouTube Channel, recognizing their global impact on the platform.

trajectory.title: Won AACTA Award for Best Online Video or Series
trajectory.description: Won the AACTA Award for Best Online Video or Series, cementing their status as Australia's top YouTube creators with over 1 billion views.

trajectory.title: Moved to Los Angeles
trajectory.description: Relocated to Los Angeles in January 2019 to pursue filmmaking opportunities while continuing to produce RackaRacka content.

trajectory.title: Talk to Me premiered at Sundance
trajectory.description: Their feature directorial debut Talk to Me premiered at the 2023 Sundance Film Festival, sparking a competitive bidding war won by A24, and grossed $92M globally.

trajectory.title: Bring Her Back released
trajectory.description: Their second feature film Bring Her Back was released in 2025 to positive reviews, continuing their commitment to making films in Australia.

name: Franz Böhm
milestone_by_age_26: His documentary feature Dear Future Children premiered at international film festivals when he was 21, setting audience records and being nominated at several of the world's major documentary festivals; his graduation film Rock, Paper, Scissors won the BAFTA for Best British Short Film in 2025, making him the youngest BAFTA winner that year.
starting_point: Born in 1999 in Gerlingen, Germany; lost his father at age 11, which led him to find escape in films. Stepped onto his first film set as a runner at age 14 in South Germany.
current_position: BAFTA-winning British-German film director with a new feature film in post-production, co-produced by ARTE, SWR, BR, ORF and SRF; member of BAFTA Connect and Directors UK.

trajectory.title: First film set experience
trajectory.description: Stepped onto his first film set as a runner at age 14 in South Germany, immediately falling in love with the filmmaking process.

trajectory.title: Short film Good Luck premiered
trajectory.description: Made his international debut with the short film Good Luck, which premiered at the British Independent Film Festival and won Best Cinematography.

trajectory.title: Dear Future Children debut feature
trajectory.description: His documentary feature debut Dear Future Children won the Audience Award at its world premiere at the Max Ophüls Prize Film Festival and at Hot Docs, distributed in 40+ countries with 90,000+ cinema viewers.

trajectory.title: Youngest German Documentary Award winner
trajectory.description: Dear Future Children won both the Audience Award and Main Jury Award at the 2022 German Documentary Award, making him the youngest director to receive this honor.

trajectory.title: Completed MA at National Film and Television School
trajectory.description: Completed his MA in Directing Fiction at the NFTS in Beaconsfield, England, where he developed his graduation film Rock, Paper, Scissors based on a true story of a Ukrainian soldier.

trajectory.title: Won BAFTA for Best British Short Film
trajectory.description: Rock, Paper, Scissors won the 2025 BAFTA for Best British Short Film, making him the youngest BAFTA winner that year, and was shortlisted for the 98th Academy Awards.

name: Harley Chamandy
milestone_by_age_26: His debut feature film Allen Sunshine won the Werner Herzog Film Award in December 2024 at age 25, making him the award's youngest-ever recipient; the film also won the TRT First Cut+ Award at Karlovy Vary International Film Festival.
starting_point: Born in 1999 in Montreal, Canada; a Lebanese and Greek-Egyptian filmmaker who grew up making short films during adolescence and attended NYU's Global Liberal Studies program, graduating in 2021.
current_position: New York City-based filmmaker whose debut feature Allen Sunshine won the Werner Herzog Film Award and is self-distributing theatrically; developing next projects.

trajectory.title: Mirage and Werner Herzog workshop
trajectory.description: His short film Mirage earned him a spot in a 10-day intensive workshop led by Werner Herzog at Cuba's Escuela Internacional de Cine y Televisión, where he was the youngest participant.

trajectory.title: The Final Act of Joey Jumbler
trajectory.description: Directed the short film The Final Act of Joey Jumbler, working with cinematographer Stéphanie Weber Biron, produced by his mother through their company Mother and Son Films.

trajectory.title: Where It's Beautiful When It Rains
trajectory.description: Wrote and directed the short film Where It's Beautiful When It Rains, continuing to build his filmmaking portfolio.

trajectory.title: Allen Sunshine wins First Cut+ Award
trajectory.description: Allen Sunshine was selected for Karlovy Vary's Eastern Promises industry program and won the TRT First Cut+ Award, with Academy Award-winning producer Alex Coco joining as executive producer.

trajectory.title: Allen Sunshine premieres at Munich and wins Werner Herzog Award
trajectory.description: The film premiered at the 41st Munich International Film Festival in June 2024, and in December 2024 Chamandy received the Werner Herzog Film Award, becoming its youngest-ever recipient.

name: Anastasia Veber
milestone_by_age_26: Her short film Trap won the Golden Bear for Best Short Film at the 72nd Berlin International Film Festival in February 2022, when she was 26 years old.
starting_point: Born in 1995 in Saint Petersburg, Russia; studied directing at the city's School of New Cinema and screenwriting at the State University of Film and Television. Inspired by the district of her childhood for the locations and mood of her films.
current_position: Director, screenwriter, and poet based in Berlin, running TRAP.AGENCY casting agency with colleague Natalya; member of the Locarno Filmmakers Academy 2023.

trajectory.title: The Glass
trajectory.description: Created her early short film The Glass while studying at the Saint Petersburg School of New Cinema.

trajectory.title: Syndrome IO wins at Oberhausen
trajectory.description: Her short film Syndrome IO won two awards at the International Short Film Festival Oberhausen and screened at numerous international festivals.

trajectory.title: Sedated and Trap production
trajectory.description: Created the short film Sedated and completed Trap, her graduation short film produced over three years with 10 unprofessional actors from her childhood district in Saint Petersburg.

trajectory.title: Golden Bear at Berlinale
trajectory.description: Trap won the Golden Bear for Best Short Film at the 72nd Berlin International Film Festival in February 2022, the highest honor for short films at Berlinale.

trajectory.title: Locarno Filmmakers Academy
trajectory.description: Selected as a member of the Locarno Filmmakers Academy 2023, a ten-day intensive program for emerging filmmakers, with Trap screened at the festival.

name: Ethan Eng
milestone_by_age_26: His debut film Therapy Dogs premiered at the 2022 Slamdance Film Festival at age 21, where he won the AGBO Fellowship ($25,000 prize and mentorship from Russo brothers); the film was also a New York Times Critics Pick.
starting_point: From a suburban Toronto neighborhood; financed his debut film partly from shifts at McDonald's, enlisting classmates to make the film while telling school officials they were making a yearbook video.
current_position: Filmmaker working on his next feature film titled 'A New Age' about the twenties and the 2020s, based in Toronto.

trajectory.title: Began filming Therapy Dogs
trajectory.description: Started production on Therapy Dogs during his senior year of high school, enlisting classmates as actors and telling school officials they were making a yearbook video.

trajectory.title: Therapy Dogs premiered at Slamdance
trajectory.description: Therapy Dogs world-premiered at the 2022 Slamdance Film Festival, making Eng the youngest filmmaker to premiere at the festival, and was released theatrically by Utopia Distribution.

trajectory.title: Won AGBO Fellowship
trajectory.description: Awarded the AGBO Fellowship at Slamdance, including a $25,000 prize and mentorship from Avengers: Endgame directors Joe and Anthony Russo.

trajectory.title: New York Times Critics Pick
trajectory.description: Therapy Dogs was named a New York Times Critics Pick, gaining critical recognition and becoming available on Apple TV through Slamdance's streaming channel.

trajectory.title: Developing second feature A New Age
trajectory.description: Currently working on his next feature film titled 'A New Age,' about the twenties and the 2020s, continuing his distinctive filmmaking approach.

name: Zelda Adams
milestone_by_age_26: Co-directed the feature film Hellbender (2021) at age 16-17 with her parents through Wonder Wheel Productions; the film was acquired by Shudder and screened at the Fantasia International Film Festival, making her one of the youngest feature directors with streaming distribution.
starting_point: Born in New York City to filmmaker parents Toby Poser and John Adams (a former Gucci model); moved to Topanga Canyon, CA at age 5, then to the Catskills. Has been operating cameras since age 9 as part of the family production company Wonder Wheel Productions.
current_position: 21-year-old filmmaker, model, and musician who has co-directed seven feature films with her family; also a Gucci model and drummer/vocalist in bands Kid Kalifornia and Hellbender.

trajectory.title: Started operating cameras
trajectory.description: Began operating cameras for Wonder Wheel Productions, the family filmmaking collaboration with parents Toby Poser and John Adams and sister Lulu.

trajectory.title: First short film NOBLE
trajectory.description: Her first short film NOBLE premiered at the Walla Walla Movie Crush and played at NY Young Film Makers, marking her early solo creative work.

trajectory.title: The Deeper You Dig released on Shudder
trajectory.description: The family's previous horror film The Deeper You Dig was acquired by Shudder, establishing Wonder Wheel Productions in the indie horror space.

trajectory.title: Co-directed Hellbender
trajectory.description: Co-directed the feature film Hellbender with her parents at age 16-17, also serving as cinematographer; the film was acquired by Shudder and screened at the Fantasia International Film Festival.

trajectory.title: Vogue and Gucci modeling recognition
trajectory.description: Profiled by Vogue as an 18-year-old filmmaker and Gucci model who reinvented the concept of 'home movies,' expanding her public profile beyond filmmaking.

trajectory.title: Seven family feature films
trajectory.description: Continued making films with Wonder Wheel Productions, having co-created seven feature films, while also pursuing modeling, music, and solo short films.

name: Aidan Zamiri
milestone_by_age_26: By age 25-26 (2020-2021), Zamiri had been signed to production company Object & Animal and directed music videos for major artists including FKA Twigs, RAYE, Dream Wife, and 645AR, establishing himself as a go-to music video director in alternative pop.
starting_point: A Glaswegian artist who studied graphic design at Central Saint Martins but quickly moved behind the camera; one of his first jobs was documenting Victoria Beckham's travels with her family across Europe and the Middle East.
current_position: Director and photographer whose feature debut The Moment (a Charli XCX mockumentary) released in 2026; known for work with Billie Eilish, Charli XCX, FKA Twigs, and Timothée Chalamet; dubbed a 'zeitgeist savant' by The Guardian.

trajectory.title: Early photography and Victoria Beckham work
trajectory.description: One of his first jobs behind the camera was documenting Victoria Beckham's travels, transitioning from graphic design at Central Saint Martins to photography and filmmaking.

trajectory.title: Signed to Object & Animal and breakout music videos
trajectory.description: Signed to production company Object & Animal and directed numerous music videos in 2020 including RAYE's 'All of My Love,' Dream Wife's 'So When You Gonna...,' and 645AR ft. FKA Twigs' 'Sum Bout U.'

trajectory.title: Extensive FKA Twigs collaboration
trajectory.description: Directed multiple music videos for FKA Twigs including 'Ride the Dragon,' 'Meta Angel,' 'Jealousy,' 'Darjeeling,' and 'Papi Bones,' cementing his reputation in alternative pop.

trajectory.title: Charli XCX '360' and Billie Eilish videos
trajectory.description: Directed Charli XCX's '360' video that launched Brat Summer, and Billie Eilish's 'Birds of a Feather' video, with Interview Magazine crediting him with 'making the music video essential again.'

trajectory.title: Feature directorial debut with The Moment
trajectory.description: Made his feature directorial debut with The Moment, a mockumentary film about Charli XCX preparing for her Brat Tour, satirizing the Brat Summer cultural phenomenon.

name: Riyaz Aly
milestone_by_age_26: Became the most-followed person on TikTok in India in May 2020 at age 16, with 45M+ TikTok followers, making him one of the top 15 most-followed TikTok creators globally before the app was banned in India.
starting_point: Born September 14, 2003 in Jaigaon, Bhutan/India to a modest family; father Liton Aly and mother Shabnam Afreen. Relocated to Mumbai to pursue content creation; has a sister Riza Afreen who is also a TikTok star.
current_position: Indian social media influencer and actor with ~27M Instagram followers, active in music videos and reality television (Lock Upp Season 2), based in Mumbai.

trajectory.title: Started on Instagram
trajectory.description: Initially started posting videos and photos on Instagram, gradually growing popular on the platform with lip-sync and fashion content.

trajectory.title: TikTok debut and rapid growth
trajectory.description: Made his TikTok debut and quickly went viral with catchy lip-sync performances and humor-centric videos, rapidly becoming one of the most-followed creators on the platform.

trajectory.title: Most-followed on TikTok India with 45M+ followers
trajectory.description: Became the most-followed person on TikTok in India in May 2020 with 45M+ followers, one of the top 15 globally, and appeared in music videos with top singers like Neha Kakkar.

trajectory.title: TikTok banned in India
trajectory.description: Following India's ban of TikTok in June 2020, shifted his audience to Instagram and YouTube to sustain and grow his fan base.

trajectory.title: Music videos and brand collaborations
trajectory.description: Continued building his career through music videos, brand collaborations, and content creation across Instagram and YouTube, maintaining his status as one of India's biggest digital creators.

trajectory.title: Lock Upp Season 2 and continued growth
trajectory.description: Participated in Lock Upp Season 2 reality show, expanding into television and maintaining ~27M Instagram followers as a nationally acknowledged digital personality.

name: Sophia Begg
milestone_by_age_26: Launched fashion brand All For Mimi in 2023 at age 19, which won the 2025 TikTok Business of the Year award, and was named to Forbes Australia 30 Under 30 in December 2025 at age 21, building an eight-figure business empire.
starting_point: From Sydney, Australia; mother is a lawyer who co-founded All For Mimi with her. Named the brand after her great-great-grandmother Ruby Musgrave, a self-made fashion icon who launched a bridal couture boutique in Mosman in the 1920s.
current_position: Co-founder of All For Mimi, an eight-figure fashion brand, and one of Australia's biggest influencers known as 'Sopha Dopha'; named to Forbes Australia 30 Under 30 in December 2025.

trajectory.title: TikTok stardom as Sopha Dopha
trajectory.description: Rose to fame on TikTok with body positivity and lifestyle content, building a massive following as a teenager in Australia.

trajectory.title: Major brand partnerships
trajectory.description: Secured partnerships with Dolce & Gabbana, Maybelline, Princess Polly, and YSL Beauty, establishing herself as a top Australian influencer.

trajectory.title: Launched All For Mimi
trajectory.description: Co-founded fashion brand All For Mimi with her mother, named after her great-great-grandmother; the brand turned over seven figures in its first year of trade.

trajectory.title: Viral 'boob job' tanks and eight-figure growth
trajectory.description: All For Mimi's viral tank tops saw 400 items sold per minute at restock, and the brand went on track for eight-figure annual revenue in its second year.

trajectory.title: Forbes Australia 30 Under 30 and TikTok Business of the Year
trajectory.description: Named to Forbes Australia 30 Under 30 in the Retail & E-commerce category in December 2025 and won TikTok Business of the Year, with All For Mimi featured in Vogue.

name: Luva de Pedreiro (Iran Ferreira)
milestone_by_age_26: Became the most-followed football influencer on Instagram in Brazil in 2022 at age 20, with 40M+ total followers across platforms (17M+ Instagram, 20M+ TikTok), and secured R$2.2 million in advertising contracts.
starting_point: Born November 7, 2001 in the small village of Tábua in Quijingue, Bahia, Brazil (population under 30,000), to a humble farming family. Played football with cloth balls made by his mother and coconuts from the yard, and worked in the fields with his father.
current_position: Brazilian digital influencer and footballer with millions of followers across platforms, based in Praia de Serrambi, Pernambuco; has a son named Cristiano Ronaldo.

trajectory.title: Started posting football videos
trajectory.description: Began posting amateur football videos on social media from a dirt field near his home in Quijingue, initially just to record his skills, using his signature gloves and catchphrases like 'Receba!' and 'Obrigado, meu Deus.'

trajectory.title: Viral fame and most-followed football influencer
trajectory.description: Videos went viral in Brazil and globally, with clubs like Barcelona, Bayern Munich, and Borussia Dortmund referencing him; became the Brazilian influencer with the most Instagram followers, the only Brazilian man followed by Instagram's official account.

trajectory.title: R$2.2M in advertising contracts
trajectory.description: Secured R$2.2 million in advertising contracts and was managed by Allan de Jesus, though the contract was later terminated.

trajectory.title: Joined AFC Ajax and fatherhood
trajectory.description: Announced he would play for AFC Ajax in Amsterdam in July 2023, and revealed he would become a father in August, naming his son Cristiano Ronaldo.

trajectory.title: Continued influencer career
trajectory.description: Maintains a massive following across YouTube (2.24M subscribers, 206M views), Instagram, and TikTok, continuing as one of Brazil's most recognized digital personalities.

name: Avneet Kaur
milestone_by_age_26: Became a household name in India playing Princess Yasmine in the TV series 'Aladdin - Naam Toh Suna Hoga' (2018-2020) starting at age 16, amassing 22M+ TikTok followers and 31M+ Instagram followers, and making her Bollywood debut in 'Tiku Weds Sheru' (2023) at age 21.
starting_point: Born October 13, 2001 in Jalandhar, Punjab, India to a Sikh family (parents Sonia Nandra and Amandeep Singh Nandra); moved to Mumbai and began her performing career at age 8 on dance reality shows.
current_position: Indian actress and social media star with 31M+ Instagram followers, active in Hindi films including Love In Vietnam (2025) and Luv Ki Arrange Marriage (2024); made Cannes debut.

trajectory.title: Dance India Dance Li'l Masters
trajectory.description: Began her performing career on Zee TV's Dance India Dance Li'l Masters, though she was eliminated before the semi-finals.

trajectory.title: Acting debut and Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa
trajectory.description: Made her acting debut in Life OK's Meri Maa and participated in Colors TV's Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa Season 5, becoming the youngest contestant on the show.

trajectory.title: Film debut in Mardaani
trajectory.description: Made her Hindi film debut in Pradeep Sarkar's Mardaani, playing the role of Meera.

trajectory.title: Chandra Nandini role
trajectory.description: Played Rajkumari Charumati in the historical drama Chandra Nandini, building her television career.

trajectory.title: Breakout role as Princess Yasmine in Aladdin
trajectory.description: Began portraying Sultana Yasmine in SAB TV's Aladdin – Naam Toh Suna Hoga, becoming a household name in India; departed the show in mid-2020 due to health issues.

trajectory.title: Bollywood debut in Tiku Weds Sheru
trajectory.description: Made her Bollywood lead debut in Tiku Weds Sheru opposite Nawazuddin Siddiqui, produced by Kangana Ranaut, and appeared in Chidiakhana.

trajectory.title: Love In Vietnam and continued film career
trajectory.description: Starred in Love In Vietnam (September 2025) and Luv Ki Arrange Marriage (2024), expanding her film career and making her Cannes debut.

name: Jannat Zubair
milestone_by_age_26: Named to Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia in 2021 at age 19, crossed 40M Instagram followers, and became India's most-followed TV actress with 49.6M Instagram followers, surpassing Shah Rukh Khan's follower count, after building a career as a child actress starting at age 7.
starting_point: Born August 29, 2001 in Mumbai, Maharashtra to Zubair Ahmad Rahmani (an actor) and Nazneen Zubair Rahmani; entered the entertainment industry at age 5-7 through auditions with her father.
current_position: Indian actress and digital influencer with ~50M Instagram followers, runs celebrity marketing agency Mad Influence; appeared on Bigg Boss and Khatron Ke Khiladi.

trajectory.title: Television debut
trajectory.description: Made her television debut with Chand Ke Paar Chalo, starting a career as a child actress.

trajectory.title: Breakthrough in Kashi
trajectory.description: Gained recognition with her lead role in Kashi – Ab Na Rahe Tera Kagaz Kora, establishing herself as a prominent child artist.

trajectory.title: Titular role in Phulwa
trajectory.description: Played the titular role in Phulwa, which established her as one of the most prominent child artists on Indian television.

trajectory.title: Lead role in Tu Aashiqui
trajectory.description: Transitioned to lead roles with the romantic drama Tu Aashiqui, portraying Pankti Sharma, marking a turning point in her career.

trajectory.title: Hichki and strategic departure from TV
trajectory.description: Made her Hindi film debut with Hichki starring Rani Mukerji, and made a conscious decision to step away from television to pivot to digital content creation.

trajectory.title: Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia
trajectory.description: Named to Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia in the Media, Marketing and Advertising category, having crossed 40M Instagram followers and become one of India's most-followed digital creators.

trajectory.title: Khatron Ke Khiladi 12 and Bigg Boss
trajectory.description: Participated in Khatron Ke Khiladi 12 and later appeared on Bigg Boss, expanding her television presence while building her digital empire to ~50M Instagram followers.

name: Sienna Mae Gomez
milestone_by_age_26: Amassed 21M+ TikTok followers across two accounts by age 17, signed with ICM Partners, secured brand deals with Maybelline and Levi's, launched a bathing suit line, and was set to star in a Netflix reality show, all by 2021 at age 17.
starting_point: Born in California; grew up dancing, singing, and performing. Of Mexican heritage on her father's side; lived with her parents and started posting content on TikTok in July 2019 for fun during Zoom school.
current_position: Content creator with over 24 million combined followers, having partnered with brands including Maybelline, Levi's, Aerie, Reebok, and Grubhub; featured in British Vogue and Buzzfeed.

trajectory.title: Started posting on TikTok
trajectory.description: Began posting content on TikTok in July 2019 for fun during pandemic Zoom school, initially making joke videos like her friends.

trajectory.title: Viral body positivity content
trajectory.description: A video of her dancing in her kitchen with her stomach out went viral, and Lizzo copied her dance; her body positivity content attracted millions of followers across two accounts.

trajectory.title: Signed with ICM Partners and major brand deals
trajectory.description: Signed with Hollywood talent agency ICM Partners, secured deals with Maybelline and Levi's, launched a YouTube channel, started a bathing suit line, and was cast in a Netflix reality show.

trajectory.title: 21M+ TikTok followers
trajectory.description: Amassed over 21 million combined followers across her two TikTok accounts, becoming one of the platform's biggest stars and a body positivity icon for young women.

trajectory.title: Continued brand expansion
trajectory.description: Expanded brand partnerships to include IPSY, Aerie, Reebok, and Grubhub, and appeared in music video trilogy alongside Becky G, Julia Michaels, and Khea.

trajectory.title: Ongoing content creation career
trajectory.description: Continues to create content across platforms with over 24 million combined followers and subscribers, maintaining her status as a prominent digital creator.

name: Lexi Rivera
milestone_by_age_26: Ranked on Forbes 2025 Top Creators list with approximately $5M in annual earnings at age 23, with 29M TikTok followers, 17.7M YouTube subscribers, and 8.1M Instagram followers, and launched the LXS clothing line.
starting_point: Born June 7, 2001 in Huntington Beach, California; the youngest of four siblings in a family where content creation is shared, including older brother Brent Rivera. A former gymnast who started appearing in her brother's videos at age 9.
current_position: Content creator and entrepreneur ranked on Forbes Top Creators 2026 with $6.7M in annual earnings; 29M TikTok followers, 18M YouTube subscribers; launched Cupshe collection in 2026.

trajectory.title: Started appearing in brother's videos
trajectory.description: Began appearing in her older brother Brent Rivera's YouTube and Vine videos at around age nine, gaining early exposure to content creation.

trajectory.title: Launched own YouTube channel
trajectory.description: Started her own YouTube channel, initially called Lexil, creating comedy, prank, and challenge content that introduced her to Brent's audience.

trajectory.title: Streamy Award nomination
trajectory.description: Nominated for a Streamy Award for Favorite Female Creator, recognizing her growing independent following beyond her brother's platform.

trajectory.title: Kids' Choice Award for Creator of the Year
trajectory.description: Won the Kids' Choice Award Blimp Award for Creator of the Year, cementing her status as a top digital creator.

trajectory.title: Forbes Top Creators list with ~$5M earnings
trajectory.description: Ranked on the Forbes 2025 Top Creators list with approximately $5M in annual earnings, 29M TikTok followers, 17.7M YouTube subscribers, and 8.1M Instagram followers; launched LXS clothing line.

trajectory.title: Forbes Top Creators 2026 and Cupshe collection
trajectory.description: Ranked on Forbes Top Creators 2026 with $6.7M in earnings; launched a collection of clothes and bathing suits with swim brand Cupshe; brand deals include Sephora, Netflix, Neutrogena, and Prada.

name: Calix Huang
milestone_by_age_26: Founded Hours, a virtual studying platform, in October 2020 at age 16, which was acquired by Fiveable in May 2021 for a six-figure sum after reaching over 2 million users; later became the youngest founder in YC's W23 batch.
starting_point: A high school junior in the Bay Area with previous tech acquisitions and startups under his belt, including Launch Tech LLC which incubated student-focused ventures; an Atlas Fellow and Emergent Ventures Fellow.
current_position: Software engineer and entrepreneur; former youngest founder in YC W23 batch, previously co-founded Captivated (YC W23) and served as Lead PM at Fiveable post-acquisition.

trajectory.title: Early startups and acquisitions
trajectory.description: Founded Launch Tech LLC, which incubated student-focused ventures like Ortexo, NPO Core, and w3Hacks, all acquired by NovaCrypt, alongside software engineering internships at Hack+ and eXomoonAI.

trajectory.title: Founded Hours virtual studying platform
trajectory.description: Founded Hours in October 2020 in response to the siloed experience of studying during the pandemic, designing and building the product to connect students through virtual study rooms.

trajectory.title: Hours acquired by Fiveable
trajectory.description: Hours was acquired by Fiveable in May 2021 after growing from 0 to 20K+ users in under 6 months; Huang joined Fiveable as Lead Product Manager, scaling the platform to 500K+ users.

trajectory.title: Software engineer at Kinetic
trajectory.description: Worked as the 2nd engineering hire at Kinetic, building NFT aggregation technology and leading initial platform development.

trajectory.title: Youngest founder in YC W23 batch
trajectory.description: Co-founded Captivated, an LLM-powered customer feedback analytics platform, as the youngest founder in Y Combinator's W23 batch, moving to San Francisco to work on the startup full-time.

name: Phoebe Gates
milestone_by_age_26: Co-founded Phia, an AI-powered shopping assistant app, and launched it publicly in April 2025 at age 22, raising an oversubscribed $35.5M Series A and reaching 1.5 million users within its first year.
starting_point: Born September 14, 2002 in Seattle, Washington as the youngest of three children of Bill Gates and Melinda French Gates; attended Lakeside School before enrolling at Stanford University, originally planning to pursue public health.
current_position: Co-founder of Phia, an AI shopping platform valued at ~$185M with over $43M raised; based in New York City with a social media following of 500K+ on Instagram and 271K on TikTok.

trajectory.title: Enrolled at Stanford University
trajectory.description: Began studying at Stanford University, originally planning to pursue a career in public health following her sister Jennifer's pre-med path.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Phia with Sophia Kianni
trajectory.description: Co-founded Phia, a digital fashion platform, in January 2023 with her Stanford roommate Sophia Kianni, initially brainstorming ideas in their dorm room.

trajectory.title: Graduated Stanford in three years
trajectory.description: Earned a Bachelor of Science in human biology with a minor in African studies from Stanford in three years, with her mother Melinda French Gates delivering the commencement speech.

trajectory.title: Phia launched in beta and seed funding
trajectory.description: Phia launched in beta in late 2024 and raised $8 million in seed funding from investors including Hailey Bieber and Kris Jenner.

trajectory.title: Phia public launch and $35.5M Series A
trajectory.description: Launched Phia publicly in April 2025, raising an oversubscribed $35.5M Series A and reaching 1.5 million users within the first year, valued at approximately $185 million.

name: Akshay Akash
milestone_by_age_26: Co-founded Stimuler, an AI-powered English fluency coaching app, in 2022 at age 21, which won Google Play's Best AI App of 2023, reached 3M+ users across 200+ countries, and was featured in Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia 2026.
starting_point: Born and raised in Saharsa, Bihar, India; attended BPS Saharsa for schooling, then went to Kota for IIT JEE preparation. Studied at IIT BHU Varanasi where he debated at world championship level and started Stimuler in his third year.
current_position: Co-founder and CEO of Stimuler, based in Bengaluru; Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia 2026 honoree; building an AI-powered English speaking coach for the global ESL population.

trajectory.title: Entered IIT BHU Varanasi
trajectory.description: Began his B.Tech at IIT BHU, where he became heavily involved in debating at world championship level and explored diverse interests across clubs and competitions.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Stimuler in third year of college
trajectory.description: Started Stimuler with co-founders Akshat Baranwal, Ankit Kumar Pandey, and Anesh Srivastav in his third year at IIT BHU, building an AI tool to help the global ESL population speak English more fluently.

trajectory.title: Google Play Best AI App of 2023
trajectory.description: Stimuler won Google Play's Best AI App of the Year award, validating strong product-market fit with 3M+ app users across 200+ countries.

trajectory.title: Raised seed funding
trajectory.description: Raised over $1M in seed funding from Lightspeed, Rebright Partners, GradCapital, Kunal Shah, and others to scale the platform.

trajectory.title: AWS Generative AI Accelerator selection
trajectory.description: Stimuler was selected as one of only three Indian companies for the AWS Generative AI Accelerator (GAIA) Class of 2025, receiving substantial cloud infrastructure support and mentorship.

trajectory.title: Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia
trajectory.description: Named to Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia Class of 2026 in the Consumer & Enterprise Technology category alongside his three co-founders, with 200K+ paying users.

name: Blake Anderson
milestone_by_age_26: Built and launched RizzGPT in 2023 at age 22, followed by Umax and Cal AI, collectively generating over $15M in ARR by age 23; named to Forbes 30 Under 30 in 2025.
starting_point: Self-taught coder who learned programming with AI tools after college; moved back home where his older brother gave him loans for groceries, treating RizzGPT as his last real chance before building a multi-million dollar app empire.
current_position: Co-founder at 10x and Cal AI; Forbes 30 Under 30 2025 honoree; Cal AI scaled to $40M+ revenue and 15M+ users with $0 in funding, operating across 11 countries.

trajectory.title: Built and launched RizzGPT
trajectory.description: Self-taught coding with AI tools and built RizzGPT, an app that recommends conversation responses; paid two TikTok creators $50 each for promotions that went viral, driving hundreds of thousands of downloads.

trajectory.title: Launched Umax looksmaxxing app
trajectory.description: Applied the same formula to build Umax, a self-improvement/looksmaxxing app that generated over $4.2 million in revenue.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Cal AI with Zach Yadegari
trajectory.description: Co-founded Cal AI, an AI-powered calorie tracking app, with then-17-year-old Zach Yadegari, scaling it to $8 million in revenue and eventually $40M+ ARR with $0 in funding.

trajectory.title: $15M+ collective ARR
trajectory.description: RizzGPT, Umax, and Cal AI collectively generated over $15.4 million in annual recurring revenue, all bootstrapped outside the traditional Silicon Valley ecosystem.

trajectory.title: Forbes 30 Under 30
trajectory.description: Named to Forbes 30 Under 30 in December 2025, having scaled Cal AI to $40M revenue and 15M users in 18 months with zero funding.

name: Daniel Bitton
milestone_by_age_26: Co-founded Crayo, an AI-powered short-form video creation tool, in 2024 at age 17, scaling it to $600,000 in monthly revenue within its first year, making approximately $7.2M annually.
starting_point: Born April 30, 2007 in Nicosia, Cyprus; started posting magic-trick videos on YouTube at age 9 and began taking content creation seriously at 12, teaching himself video editing. Left high school to pursue entrepreneurial ambitions.
current_position: 19-year-old Cypriot entrepreneur; co-founder of Crayo (AI video tool at ~$600K/month) and CEO of Content Rewards (creator-marketing marketplace with 300K+ creators and 200+ brands including the NFL and ElevenLabs).

trajectory.title: Started posting YouTube videos
trajectory.description: Began posting magic-trick videos on YouTube from Nicosia, Cyprus, starting his content creation journey at a young age.

trajectory.title: Learned video editing and content creation
trajectory.description: Started taking content creation seriously, teaching himself video editing and building skills that would later inform his product development.

trajectory.title: Six-figure monthly income from Snapchat Shows
trajectory.description: Found success with Snapchat Shows, creating news-based content that earned him 10M followers and six figures monthly; bought his mother a Rolex.

trajectory.title: Pivoted to YouTube Shorts and TikTok
trajectory.description: When Snapchat changed its payout algorithm and his income suffered, pivoted to YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels, gaining ~4 million subscribers across channels.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Crayo AI
trajectory.description: Co-founded Crayo with Musa Mustafa, an AI-powered short-form video creation tool, with $10K in savings; scaled to $600,000/month in revenue within its first year with 2.5M+ videos created.

trajectory.title: Launched Content Rewards as CEO
trajectory.description: Relaunched Content Rewards on Whop as CEO, a creator-marketing marketplace used by 300,000+ creators and 200+ brands including the NFL, ElevenLabs, and Polymarket, with combined business revenue of ~$1M/month.

name: Artem Middleton
milestone_by_age_26: Co-founded Roforco, a Roblox game studio, in September 2021 at age 16, joined YC's Summer 2022 batch at 17 as the 3rd youngest founder in YC history, scaled to over 100 million users and 10M monthly active users, and raised $1.5M from Paul Graham and other investors.
starting_point: Started building on Roblox at age 12, with a background in Math Olympiad, ML, and game development; dropped out of high school to join YC at 17, having built viral consumer products since age 12.
current_position: 3x founder and strategic polymath with 10+ years building on Roblox; previously CEO of Roforco (exited), backed by YC and Paul Graham; advised F100 companies and managed a $600K fund.

trajectory.title: Started building on Roblox
trajectory.description: Began building games and experiences on Roblox, eventually becoming a top-100 earning developer with over 27 games and 3.7 billion play sessions.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Roforco
trajectory.description: Co-founded Roforco, a Roblox game studio, in September 2021, bootstrapping a best-in-class ad agency to $500K revenue in 6 months with brand partners including Unilever and Cosmopolitan.

trajectory.title: YC Summer 2022 as 3rd youngest founder
trajectory.description: Joined Y Combinator's Summer 2022 batch at age 17 as the 3rd youngest founder in YC history, dropping out of high school to participate.

trajectory.title: Raised $1.5M from Paul Graham
trajectory.description: Raised $1.5M at a $20M valuation from Paul Graham and other top investors, with Paul Graham describing him as a 'half-baked Bill Gates' and Roblox CEO David Baszucki calling him 'crazy effective.'

trajectory.title: Scaled to 100M+ users and 10M MAU
trajectory.description: Roforco launched 7 original titles played by over 100 million users, reaching a peak of 10.2 million monthly active users, with games including Disney World Magic Kingdom Theme Park.

trajectory.title: Roforco exit and continued ventures
trajectory.description: Exited Roforco (February 2024) after 2.5 years, having led a global team of 35; continued as head of GTM scaling SaaS from $0 to $150K ARR in 3 months and managed a $600K fund with 2.4x ROI.

name: Aryan Sharma
milestone_by_age_26: Co-founded Induced AI, an AI-powered browser automation platform, in 2023 at age 18 and raised $2.3M in seed funding led by Sam Altman (OpenAI CEO) and Peak XV Partners, with backing from SignalFire, SV Angel, and Daniel Gross.
starting_point: Working in tech since age 13; after high school, received a full scholarship from Eric Schmidt (former Google CEO) to attend any university in America but decided to continue building products independently instead of going to college.
current_position: Co-founder and CEO of Induced AI, an AI-powered browser automation platform based in Silicon Valley; previously founding engineer at Layer3, a web3 user acquisition and retention platform.

trajectory.title: Started working in tech
trajectory.description: Began working in technology at age 13, building products and learning from founders, operators, and investors around the world.

trajectory.title: Founding engineer at Layer3
trajectory.description: Served as founding engineer at Layer3, a web3 user acquisition and retention solution provider, gaining early startup engineering experience.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Induced AI
trajectory.description: Co-founded Induced AI with Ayush Pathak in early 2023 in Silicon Valley, building an AI-powered browser automation platform that spins up Chromium-based browser instances to automate workflows.

trajectory.title: Raised $2.3M seed from Sam Altman
trajectory.description: Raised $2.3M in seed funding led by Sam Altman (OpenAI CEO) and Peak XV Partners, with backing from SignalFire, SV Angel, Daniel Gross, Nat Friedman's AI grant, and Balaji Srinivasan.

trajectory.title: Scaling Induced AI
trajectory.description: Continued building Induced AI as a lean team, with bots performing 150K+ actions for enterprises, focusing on automating repetitive back-office workflows like writing emails and shortlisting candidates.

name: Ayush Pathak
milestone_by_age_26: Co-founded Induced AI in 2023 at age 19 and raised $2.3M in seed funding led by Sam Altman (OpenAI CEO) and Peak XV Partners, having previously been a founding engineer at Thirdweb, a web3 development platform.
starting_point: In tech since age 12; got his first job at 16 and started his first company at 17. After high school, decided not to go to college to build things full-time. Ran a program called JugaGrant providing $2K grants for crypto project hackers in India.
current_position: Co-founder and CTO of Induced AI, based in Palo Alto; Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree; previously founding engineer at Thirdweb where he built SDKs used by 10K+ developers.

trajectory.title: Started in tech
trajectory.description: Began working in technology at age 12, building side projects and learning programming independently.

trajectory.title: First job and early ventures
trajectory.description: Got his first job at 16 and started his first company at 17, building a range of projects from side projects to serious startups.

trajectory.title: Founding engineer at Thirdweb
trajectory.description: Served as founding engineer at Thirdweb, a web3 development platform, from October 2021 to May 2022, building infrastructure and SDKs used by 10,000+ developers.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Induced AI
trajectory.description: Co-founded Induced AI with Aryan Sharma in July 2022, building actionable AI for enterprises with a focus on browser-native workflow automation.

trajectory.title: Raised $2.3M seed funding
trajectory.description: Raised $2.3M in seed funding led by Sam Altman and Peak XV Partners, with participation from SignalFire, SV Angel, IDEO CoLab Ventures, Superscrypt, and OnDeck.

trajectory.title: Scaling Induced AI as CTO
trajectory.description: Continues as CTO of Induced AI, with bots performing 150K+ actions for enterprises, and was named to Forbes 30 Under 30.

name: Henry Langmack
milestone_by_age_26: Co-founded Cal AI, an AI-powered calorie-tracking app, in 2024 at age 17, scaling it to over $30M in annual revenue and 15 million downloads before its acquisition by MyFitnessPal in December 2025.
starting_point: A high school student who co-founded Cal AI with classmate Zach Yadegari; built the AI-powered nutrition app while in high school, scaling it to a massive business before acquisition.
current_position: Co-founder and CTO of Cal AI (acquired by MyFitnessPal); the app reached $50M ARR and continues operating as a standalone product within MyFitnessPal's portfolio.

trajectory.title: Early coding and product development
trajectory.description: Developed coding skills and began exploring AI-powered app concepts while in high school, laying the groundwork for Cal AI.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Cal AI
trajectory.description: Co-founded Cal AI with high school friend Zach Yadegari in March 2024, building an AI-powered calorie tracking app that lets users snap a photo of meals to get nutritional breakdowns.

trajectory.title: Rapid growth to millions of users
trajectory.description: Cal AI scaled rapidly, reaching 15 million downloads and over $30M in annual revenue within under two years, with $0 in external funding.

trajectory.title: Scaled to $50M ARR
trajectory.description: Cal AI grew to $50M ARR with Henry leading the development team and running extensive A/B tests, operating across 11 countries with 30-40 employees.

trajectory.title: Acquired by MyFitnessPal
trajectory.description: Cal AI was acquired by MyFitnessPal in December 2025/March 2026 after nearly a year of deal talks; the team of seven employees joined MyFitnessPal, with the app continuing as a standalone product.

name: Hunter Rice
milestone_by_age_26: Founded Iconic Hearts and launched Sendit, a social networking app integrated with Snapchat, on the Apple App Store in November 2018 at age 24, reaching over 1,000 daily downloads and generating subscription revenue by 2020 at age 26, eventually growing to 25 million monthly active users.
starting_point: From Los Angeles, California; grew up around entertainment and gravitated toward tech and startups. Attended Southern Methodist University in Dallas, co-founded Alpha Epsilon Pi fraternity, and worked on a campus communication tool called Sides before graduating with a business administration degree in 2016.
current_position: Founder of Iconic Hearts, Inc. in Santa Monica; Sendit and Noteit apps have been used by over 250 million people worldwide, with Sendit ranking in the top 20 free social networking apps on Apple's App Store.

trajectory.title: Co-founded FrostbiteLA streetwear brand
trajectory.description: Co-founded FrostbiteLA, a streetwear brand, from July 2009 to May 2012 during his early years, showing early entrepreneurial instincts.

trajectory.title: Graduated from SMU
trajectory.description: Graduated from Southern Methodist University with a degree in business administration, having co-founded Alpha Epsilon Pi fraternity and built a campus communication tool called Sides.

trajectory.title: Product designer at vAtomic Systems
trajectory.description: Worked as a product designer at vAtomic Systems, Inc. from September 2017 to November 2018, gaining tech industry experience.

trajectory.title: Founded Iconic Hearts and launched Sendit
trajectory.description: Founded Iconic Hearts, Inc. in November 2018 and launched Sendit, a Snapchat-integrated social networking app with augmented reality icebreakers, on the Apple App Store.

trajectory.title: Sendit reached 1,000+ daily downloads
trajectory.description: Sendit reached over 1,000 daily downloads and began generating subscription revenue, ranking as the No. 3 app among Lifestyle apps in Apple's App Store.

trajectory.title: 25M monthly active users and Noteit launch
trajectory.description: Iconic Hearts' apps Sendit and Noteit reached 25 million monthly active users globally, with 250 million total users; backed by Trousdale Ventures.

name: Brendan Rius
milestone_by_age_26: Co-created MEE6 in 2016, which became the world's most popular Discord bot, trusted by 22 million+ servers and growing into a multimillion-dollar bootstrapped business by age 26.
starting_point: Started coding at age 12 and built his first app at 12; launched a file-sharing platform at 14 used by thousands. Hacked the Silicon Valley Bank website, earning an invitation to Le Web conference, and later hacked the French Ministry of Education, earning a meeting with the French Internal Security Agency.
current_position: Co-founder of MEE6, the world's most popular Discord bot with 22M+ servers; recently launched T22, a community management platform for Telegram; bootstrapped with co-founder Anis Belkacem.

trajectory.title: Started coding and built first app
trajectory.description: Developed a passion for coding at age 12 and built his first app, launching a file-sharing platform at 14 that was used by thousands of users.

trajectory.title: White-hat hacking recognition
trajectory.description: Hacked the Silicon Valley Bank website, earning an invitation to Le Web conference in Paris, and later hacked the French Ministry of Education, earning a meeting with the French Internal Security Agency.

trajectory.title: Xavier Niel's No MBA Program
trajectory.description: Selected as one of five people for Xavier Niel's No MBA Program, an intense nine-month crash course in business that sparked his entrepreneurial passion.

trajectory.title: Co-created MEE6
trajectory.description: Co-created MEE6 with Anis Belkacem, an all-in-one Discord bot packaging 40+ modules for moderation, engagement, role management, and more, configurable through a no-code dashboard.

trajectory.title: MEE6 trusted by 22M+ servers
trajectory.description: MEE6 grew to be trusted by over 22 million Discord servers, becoming the most popular Discord bot in the world as a bootstrapped, multimillion-dollar business with 45 employees.

trajectory.title: Launched T22 for Telegram
trajectory.description: Launched T22, a community management platform for Telegram built on the same premise as MEE6, expanding their community management tools to new platforms.

name: Frederik Riedel
milestone_by_age_26: Created 'one sec,' a screen-time app that cut social media usage by 57%, gained peer-reviewed research validation, a US patent, and partnerships with Stanford and Cambridge by age 26.
starting_point: Started making apps at age 14 in high school without formal education; later studied software engineering at the University of Stuttgart (2013-2017) to professionalize his skills. Founded riedel.wtf GmbH in 2015 in Berlin.
current_position: Founder of one sec, an indie screen-time app with peer-reviewed research validation, a US patent, and partnerships with Stanford, Cambridge, the Max Planck Institute, and three national governments.

trajectory.title: Founded riedel.wtf GmbH
trajectory.description: Founded his company riedel.wtf GmbH in Berlin in 2015 while studying software engineering at the University of Stuttgart.

trajectory.title: Graduated University of Stuttgart
trajectory.description: Completed his B.Sc. in Software Engineering at the University of Stuttgart, professionalizing his self-taught coding skills.

trajectory.title: Created one sec prototype
trajectory.description: Built the first prototype of one sec on a weekend to solve his own social media habit; accidentally triggered it 20 seconds after installing it, and his screen time dropped 50% within two weeks.

trajectory.title: Viral growth and Max Planck research
trajectory.description: A single viral tweet with only 700 followers drove months of growth; partnered with the Max Planck Institute for peer-reviewed research showing one sec reduced social media usage by 57%.

trajectory.title: US patent granted
trajectory.description: Obtained U.S. Patent No. 17/931,047 for the one sec app, protecting the novel approach to interrupting unconscious social media use.

trajectory.title: Stanford and Cambridge partnerships
trajectory.description: Established partnerships with Stanford University and Cambridge University, along with three national governments, validating the app's effectiveness through academic research.

name: Tony Dinh
milestone_by_age_26: Launched DevUtils in October 2020, an all-in-one developer toolbox for macOS that gained traction on Hacker News and Product Hunt, marking the start of a solo indie career that would exceed $1M ARR by age 30.
starting_point: From Vietnam; started writing code at age 15 in high school using Visual Basic. Worked as a software engineer for 7 years across frontend, backend, mobile apps, and game dev before quitting to become a full-time indie hacker.
current_position: Full-time indie hacker running multiple profitable products including DevUtils, Xnapper, and previously Black Magic (sold to Hypefury); total monthly revenue of $15-20K, exceeding $1M ARR; author of an indie hacking book.

trajectory.title: Started coding professionally
trajectory.description: Began writing code at age 15 and started professional software engineering work, accumulating 7 years of experience across frontend, backend, mobile, and game development.

trajectory.title: Launched DevUtils
trajectory.description: Built the first version of DevUtils in about 2 weeks, an all-in-one developer toolbox for macOS; posted on Hacker News and reached the top for several hours, generating initial revenue.

trajectory.title: Quit job for full-time indie hacking
trajectory.description: Handed in his notice and quit his job on September 20, 2021, becoming a full-time indie hacker with 2 years of savings as a buffer.

trajectory.title: Launched Black Magic and Xnapper
trajectory.description: Built Black Magic (a Twitter analytics SaaS reaching $11K MRR) and Xnapper (a screenshot tool), running three profitable products simultaneously with $15-20K monthly revenue.

trajectory.title: Sold Black Magic and exceeded $1M ARR
trajectory.description: Sold Black Magic to Hypefury and continued running DevUtils and Xnapper, with total revenue exceeding $1M ARR; wrote a ~275-page book about his indie hacking journey.

name: Anthony Fu
milestone_by_age_26: Created VueUse (widely-used Vue composition utilities), Vitest (popular testing framework), and Slidev (presentation framework for developers) by age 26, becoming a core team member of Vue, Nuxt, and Vite.
starting_point: A computer science student and freelance software engineer who became an open-source enthusiast and maintainer; joined GitHub in 2015 and built a reputation through elegant interfaces and high-quality code in the Vue.js ecosystem.
current_position: Open source developer at Vercel and NuxtLabs; creator of VueUse, Vitest, Slidev, UnoCSS, Elk, and Type Challenges; core team member of Vue, Nuxt, and Vite; ~40K GitHub followers.

trajectory.title: Started open source on GitHub
trajectory.description: Joined GitHub and began contributing to open source projects, developing expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue, and related technologies.

trajectory.title: Created VueUse
trajectory.description: Created VueUse, a collection of essential Vue Composition API utilities that became widely adopted in the Vue.js ecosystem, receiving thousands of GitHub stars.

trajectory.title: Created Vitest and Slidev
trajectory.description: Created Vitest, a blazing fast unit test framework powered by Vite, and Slidev, a presentation framework for developers; also authored the unplugin library unifying APIs between Webpack and Vite.

trajectory.title: Became core team member of Vue, Nuxt, and Vite
trajectory.description: Joined the core teams of Vue.js, Nuxt, and Vite, having integrated Vite into Nuxt 3 resulting in 50x faster development time.

trajectory.title: Joined Vercel as software engineer
trajectory.description: Began working as a software engineer at Vercel while continuing open source work, creating additional projects including UnoCSS and Elk.

trajectory.title: Continued open source leadership
trajectory.description: Maintains numerous popular open source projects with 15,000+ stars on personal projects, and is recognized as a leading figure in the Vue.js and frontend tooling ecosystem.

name: Ritwick Dey
milestone_by_age_26: Created VS Code Live Server in 2017, which grew to 6,800+ GitHub stars and became one of the most popular VS Code extensions for web developers, with millions of installs by age 26.
starting_point: From India; holds a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science from Brainware Group of Institutions. Started as a freelance full stack developer on Upwork specializing in Angular, React.js, and Node.js before moving into professional roles.
current_position: Software Development Engineer III at Setu, working on financial APIs and automation; co-founder at Panto; creator of the widely-used VS Code Live Server extension.

trajectory.title: Created VS Code Live Server
trajectory.description: Created the VS Code Live Server extension on June 27, 2017, which launches a development local server with live reload for static and dynamic pages, growing to 6,800+ GitHub stars.

trajectory.title: Freelance full stack developer
trajectory.description: Worked as a freelance full stack developer on Upwork from July 2018 to July 2019, specializing in Angular, React.js, and Node.js, with internships at Wit By Bit and JS Tigers.

trajectory.title: Frontend Developer at GreedyGame
trajectory.description: Joined GreedyGame as a Frontend Developer in June 2019, later promoted to Senior Software Engineer in April 2021, responsible for product development and performance optimization.

trajectory.title: SDE II at Setu
trajectory.description: Joined Setu as Software Development Engineer II in January 2022, working on WhatsApp lending bots and financial services projects.

trajectory.title: SDE III at Setu and Live Server growth
trajectory.description: Promoted to SDE III at Setu in May 2023, focusing on financial APIs and automation; VS Code Live Server reached millions of installs, becoming one of the most popular VS Code extensions for web developers.

name: Liyas Thomas
milestone_by_age_26: Created Hoppscotch in 2019, an open-source API development ecosystem that grew to 30K+ GitHub stars and 300K+ users by age 26, becoming a popular open-source alternative to Postman.
starting_point: From Kerala, India; a self-learned web developer who graduated in computer science engineering in 2019. Previously worked as a construction foreman, mason, and chef before becoming a developer, believing titles don't matter—only doing what you love.
current_position: Founder and core maintainer of Hoppscotch, an open-source API development ecosystem with 79K+ GitHub stars and 300K+ users, based in Kerala, India.

trajectory.title: Graduated and joined Zartek Technologies
trajectory.description: Graduated in computer science engineering in August 2019 and joined an early-stage startup called Zartek, where his job involved tedious manual API testing.

trajectory.title: Created Hoppscotch
trajectory.description: Built Hoppscotch in six hours as an MVP to solve his own API testing problem, creating a lightweight, browser-based API request builder that ran on his 10-year-old PC that couldn't handle Electron-based tools like Postman.

trajectory.title: Hoppscotch goes viral on GitHub
trajectory.description: Hoppscotch went viral on GitHub, rapidly accumulating stars and users, becoming an overnight success as an open-source alternative to Postman.

trajectory.title: Reached 30K+ GitHub stars and 300K+ users
trajectory.description: Hoppscotch grew to 30,000+ GitHub stars and 300,000+ users, featured by GitHub's ReadME project and winning multiple open source awards.

trajectory.title: Hoppscotch ecosystem expansion
trajectory.description: Expanded Hoppscotch into a full API development ecosystem with web, desktop, and CLI versions, offline/on-prem/cloud options, growing to 79K+ GitHub stars with 320+ contributors.
